name: Maya File Browser
description: Maya-side asset browser, launched from inside Maya. Formerly named 'Ukore Browser' (renamed to avoid confusion with unrelated similarly-named things); technical id stays 'ukore_browser' for backward compatibility with already-enabled repos. Contributes its maya-scripts folder (plus UkoreHub's own app root) to the Maya Launcher env bridge — does not launch Maya itself, and still depends on MayaToolkit's tmlib/UkoreMaya staying on PYTHONPATH.
